text: 乘联分会会长崔东树发文分析新能源车锂电池市场：9月，我国动力和其它电池合计产量为237GWh，同比增长57%；1-9月，我国动力和其它电池合计产量为1833GWh，同比增长63%。今年电池增速从60%以上逐步下降，由于动力电池需求低迷，加之出口退税调整，电池需求逐步降速。
text_en: Cui Dongshu, president of the China Passenger Car Association, wrote an article analyzing the new energy vehicle lithium battery market: In September, China's total output of power and other batteries was 237 GWh, up 57% year on year; from January to September, China's total output of power and other batteries was 1,833 GWh, up 63% year on year. This year, battery growth has gradually declined from above 60%, as weak demand for power batteries, combined with adjustments to export tax rebates, has gradually slowed battery demand.
